Recommended tool: Africa's Talking API Suite, or Safaricom Direct Enterprise SDP Gateway
What it does: The offline engine (Section 5.2.3.3): opt-in bulk 2G SMS to registered voters across 40 wards, the zero-rated USSD menu (*[shortcode]#), and inbound field reports from the campaign-owned ward network (Section 5.1.3)
Data it holds: Phone numbers (MSISDN), ward tags, USSD menu responses, delivery-receipt timestamps, opt-out logs
DPA 2019 exposure: HIGH: direct personal data (Section 5.2.3.4). Opt-in confirmation logs, STOP processed within 15 seconds, signed data processing agreements with the aggregator
Decision awaited: Vendor: Africa's Talking or Safaricom SDP Enterprise

Recommended tool: Custom PostgreSQL with a Hasura / Directus admin UI, or a CiviCRM instance
What it does: The single source of truth for supporters (Section 5.2.4.1): profiles, 40-ward linkages, demographic classes, volunteer skills, delegate tracking, contact history
Data it holds: Encrypted names, phone numbers (AES-256), constituency, ward and polling-station IDs, gender, age cohort, livelihood, consent timestamps, interaction logs
DPA 2019 exposure: CRITICAL: the core store of personal data. Row-level security, MFA for every operator, role-based access, daily encrypted off-site backups, audit log of every query
Decision awaited: Architecture: custom PostgreSQL or open-source CiviCRM

Recommended tool: Buffer / Hootsuite Enterprise to publish; Brand24 / Talkwalker to listen
What it does: Scheduling across Facebook, X, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube; 24/7 monitoring of Kamba and national political keywords ("Dr. Makali Mulu", "Kitui Governor 2027", "Kitui Central CDF", "Wiper Primaries", "Kalonzo Musyoka"), flagging rumours, attacks and local issues in real time
Data it holds: Public posts, comments, engagement metrics, sentiment scores, influencer handles, public reach
DPA 2019 exposure: LOW TO MODERATE: public posts and aggregated sentiment only; compliant with Section 5.2.3.4 provided no profile is scraped or merged into voter records without consent

Recommended tool: Metabase Open Source, self-hosted on private cloud, or Apache Superset
What it does: Real-time dashboards for the Campaign Manager and Dr. Mulu: progress to the 200,000 threshold across all 40 wards, SMS delivery rates, daily field reports, effort per ward
Data it holds: Aggregated, anonymised statistics: voter counts, ward completion percentages, reach cross-tabulations; no raw unencrypted personal data shown
DPA 2019 exposure: MINIMAL: aggregated, anonymised views only, restricted to authorised war-room IP addresses via VPN and MFA

Recommended tool: Next.js web platform with an interactive GIS ward map, on Vercel / Cloudflare edge hosting
What it does: The public evidence engine: 13 years of Kitui Central NG-CDF project records (schools, boreholes, dispensaries, bursary audits) and a "Kitui Economic Blueprint" where citizens track proposed ward investments for the 2027–2032 term
Data it holds: Public infrastructure records, project GPS coordinates, photos and video, completion certificates, public feedback forms
DPA 2019 exposure: LOW: public government and policy data; feedback forms collect consented contact details under an explicit privacy policy
Decision awaited: Design mockups and public domain registration
